title: Spicy Idli Stir Fry
description: A unique Thai-inspired dish combining crispy idli with sweet jaggery and spicy zingy. Served with a side of sake for an added depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Zingy
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh for an added kick

ingredients.name: Sake
ingredients.notes: Sake adds a rich umami flavor

instructions: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Add the sake to the pan and stir to combine with the zingy.
Add the grated jaggery to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the crispy idli to the pan and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Optional: Garnish with additional zingy and jaggery for a pop of color and added flavor.
